Source does not give stack ore count, completed prospect clicks, zero outcomes or item ID. The reported name resembles a CUT gem and is not safe to map to Golden Draenite 23112 or Brilliant Golden Draenite 23113: no confident raw prospect output identity; keep outputItemID null and exclude from item-specific drop calibration until original clarification.
